title: Enigma of Fear
context: A paranormal investigation adventure in the Paranormal Order universe. Mia, an Ordo Realitas investigator, is searching for her missing father, Mr. Verity, in the Perimeter, a place known as the place that does not exist. Lupi accompanies Mia, and Samuel Norte and Agatha Volkomenn assist the investigation.
translation_policy: Use this profile only to choose natural wording, pronouns, names, and tone.
Do not add lore or information that is not present in the source line.
If OCR text is obviously partial, translate only the readable part without inventing the missing words.
If the speaker is unknown, keep the translation neutral and avoid strongly gendered first-person pronouns.
Avoid unrelated nouns, character names, or world terms unless they appear in the source text or are clearly required by context.

terms.Lupi: Dog's name. Keep in Latin letters unless a Japanese rendering is intentionally chosen.
terms.Verity: Proper name. Keep in Latin letters unless a Japanese rendering is intentionally chosen.
terms.Mr. Verity: Mia's father and the leader of Ordo Realitas. Keep as Mr. Verity or translate as Verity depending on context.
terms.Perimeter: A location known as the place that does not exist.

MIA.name: Mia
MIA.role: Protagonist. Paranormal investigator from Ordo Realitas. Daughter of Mr. Verity. Lupi's companion.
MIA.voice_ja: 若い女性。勇敢で親しみやすい。基本は自然な女性寄りの口調。一人称は迷う場合「私」。強すぎる男言葉の「俺」は避ける。

SAMUEL.name: Samuel Norte
SAMUEL.role: Hacker and paranormal investigator. Friend and ally of Mia and Lupi. Also called Sam.
SAMUEL.voice_ja: 若い男性。くだけた、友好的で軽い口調。一人称は必要なら「俺」または文脈により省略。乱暴すぎない。

AGATHA.name: Agatha Volkomenn
AGATHA.role: Occultism specialist and support agent assisting Mia.
AGATHA.voice_ja: 若い女性。知識があり落ち着いた口調。必要以上に堅くしない。

LUPI.name: Lupi
LUPI.role: Mia's dog. Cheerful and loyal, but fearful in paranormal situations.
LUPI.voice_ja: 犬の鳴き声や短い反応は自然な日本語の擬音・短文にする。

MR. VERITY.name: Mr. Verity
MR. VERITY.role: Mia's father and leader of Ordo Realitas.
MR. VERITY.voice_ja: 成人男性。落ち着いた指導者寄りの口調。
